BiblicalUsage: Challamuwth is probably purslain, a tasteless plant — and it appears once, when Job asks whether what is unsavoury can be eaten without salt, or whether there is any taste in the white of an egg.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Job's tasteless plant is his whole complaint in one bite: life with no salt in it, and no one to season it.
